## What's New in v1.6.7 — Removed Native Black Title Bar

### 🚫 System Bar Cleanup
- **Stripped Legacy ActionBar:** Applied `@style/NoActionBarTheme` to `MainComposeActivity` and `MainActivity` in `AndroidManifest.xml`.
- **Full Edge-to-Edge Canvas:** Removed duplicate top black header bar across all screens, allowing Jetpack Compose header to take full edge-to-edge screen space.
